name: @nomad-connector/contract
description: Nomad Connector: ILP connector hub as a HotPocket contract (everpocket, Xahau multisig).

scripts.build: ncc build src/index.js -o dist --minify=false --external bufferutil --external utf-8-validate && cp hp.cfg.override dist/ && cp nomad.config.json dist/ 2>/dev/null || cp nomad.config.example.json dist/nomad.config.json
scripts.start: npm run build && hpdevkit deploy dist
scripts.build:local: ncc build src/index.js -o dist --minify=false --external bufferutil --external utf-8-validate && cp ../deploy/local/hp.cfg.local.override dist/hp.cfg.override && cp ../deploy/local/nomad.config.local.json dist/nomad.config.json
scripts.build:testnet: ncc build src/index.js -o dist --minify=false --external bufferutil --external utf-8-validate && cp ../deploy/testnet/hp.cfg.testnet.override dist/hp.cfg.override && cp ../deploy/testnet/nomad.config.testnet.json dist/nomad.config.json
scripts.build:local-ledger: ncc build src/index.js -o dist-local --minify=false --external bufferutil --external utf-8-validate && cp ../deploy/local/hp.cfg.local.override dist-local/hp.cfg.override && cp ../deploy/local/nomad.config.local-ledger.json dist-local/nomad.config.json
